general_ui_ux_guidelines: Never rely on default browser transparent backgrounds in fixed headers or dropdown menus; always use blur and semi-opaque fill.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, link, and key metric block has a explicit data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case.
Maintain strict APCA/WCAG accessibility contrast: dark text on light cards, bold white text on blue CTA buttons.
Implement smooth micro-interactions on hover for cards (subtle translate-y, border glow, shadow depth).
Use Framer Motion with reduced-motion fallbacks for performance and smooth UX.
